    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="click | dismiss | group"`: Present when it opened or closed in a way that should skip the motion: `click` when the keyboard pressed its trigger or an item, `dismiss` when Escape closed it, `group` when focus or the pointer went from one menu of a bar to another.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the arrow cannot sit at the trigger's centre.
- item: An action. Choosing it closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- linkItem: An item that is a link. Choosing it follows the link and closes the menu.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItem: An item that is checked or not. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- checkboxItemIndicator: A mark a checkbox item shows while it is checked.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- radioGroup: Radio items of which one is chosen.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItem: One choice of a radio group. Choosing it leaves the menu open.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- radioItemIndicator: A mark a radio item shows while it is the chosen one.
    - `data-checked`: Present when it is checked.
    - `data-unchecked`: Present when it is not checked.
- submenuTrigger: An item that opens a menu beside it.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when its menu is open.
    - `data-highlighted`: Present on the item the pointer or the keyboard is on.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

These parts write no state attribute or CSS variable of their own: `group`, `groupLabel` and `separator`.

### DateField

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/date-field"
```

`<kui-date-field>`: `<kui-date-field>` around `kui-part="root"`, which holds a `<template kui-each="segments">` with the `segment` each part of the date is typed in (`{type}` and `{index}` say which), and the hidden `input` a form reads. `value`, `default-value`, `locale`, `min`, `max`, `disabled`, `read-only`, `required`, `name`, `form`; `placeholders` and `calendarSystem` (an instance from `@internationalized/date`) as properties; it tells `value-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `value` (string): The day typed, once all of it is; `null` until then.
- `default-value` (string): The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `locale` (string): The language and region that order the day, the month and the year and put what stands between them (`"en-US"`: month/day/year). Give it: a server does not know the reader's.
- `min` (string): The first and the last day it takes: outside them it says it is invalid.
- `max` (string): The last day it takes.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `read-only` (boolean): Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required` (boolean): Needed: a date left half typed is then invalid (`data-invalid`).
- `name` (string): The name it is submitted under, by its hidden input.
- `form` (string): The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Properties only:

- `placeholders`: What an empty part shows. Default: `dd`, `mm`, `yyyy`, `era`.
- `calendarSystem`: The calendar its parts are typed in, when it is not the Gregorian one: an instance from `@internationalized/date` (`new PersianCalendar()`), as a calendar takes it. Its days, months, years and eras are the parts' ranges; the value is still an ISO day. In a calendar with several eras (Japanese, Minguo, Ethiopic), the era is a part of its own.

Events:

- `value-change`: `event.detail.value`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `value` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`
- `segment`
- `input`

Lists (`<template kui-each="…">`): `segments`.

Anatomy:

```
<kui-date-field>
  root
    <template kui-each="segments">
      segment (repeated)
    input
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The field: a group of the date's parts.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="era | day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is: the era only in a calendar of several eras.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.

This part writes no state attribute or CSS variable of its own: `input`.

### DatePicker

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/date-picker"
```

`<kui-date-picker>`: `<kui-date-picker>`: a date field and a calendar in a popover that are one value. A `kui-part="field"` with a date field's `segments` template and `input` (with `mode="range"`, two: `kui-range="start"` and `kui-range="end"`); a `trigger` button; a `clear` button and `preset` buttons (`kui-value`: a day, or a range's first and last with a comma between); and a `portal` with a `positioner` around the `popup`, which holds the `calendar` with a calendar's parts and templates. `value` (a range as a preset's), `default-value`, `mode`, `open`, `default-open`, `locale`, `min`, `max`, `calendar-system`, `fixed-weeks`, `months` (each drawn in a `<template kui-each="months">`), `paged-navigation`, `month`, `default-month`, `disabled`, `read-only`, `required`, `name`, `form`; `isDateUnavailable` and `placeholders` as properties; it tells `value-change`, `open-change` and `month-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `value` (string): The day, typed or picked; with `mode: "range"` a first and a last day, each typed in its own field or both picked in the one calendar. `null` for none.
- `default-value` (string): The value it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `mode` (string): One day (the default), or a first and a last (`"range"`): two fields, `DatePicker.Field` with `range="start"` and `range="end"`, and the calendar in range mode, which stays open until the range is whole. Read once.
- `open` (boolean): Whether the calendar is open, when the caller holds it.
- `default-open` (boolean): Whether the calendar starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `locale` (string): The language and region of the field and the calendar. Give it: a server does not know.
- `min` (string): The first and the last day that can be typed or picked.
- `max` (string): The last day that can be typed or picked.
- `calendar-system` (string): The calendar its months are laid out in and its field typed in, when it is not the Gregorian one. The value is an ISO day whatever it is.
- `fixed-weeks` (boolean): Always six rows of days.
- `months` (number): How many months the calendar shows side by side (1 by default).
- `paged-navigation` (boolean): With several `months`: whether Previous and Next turn them all rather than one month.
- `month` (string): The month the calendar shows (the first, with several), when the caller holds it.
- `default-month` (string): The month the calendar starts on, when the caller does not hold `month`. Read once.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: it cannot be changed.
- `read-only` (boolean): Shown as it is, focusable, not changeable.
- `required` (boolean): Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it empty is then invalid, and the day picked, pressed again in the calendar, stays picked. Without it, that press empties the field and closes the calendar.
- `name` (string): The name it is submitted under.
- `form` (string): The id of the form it belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Properties only:

- `isDateUnavailable`: Days that cannot be picked in the calendar.
- `placeholders`: What an empty part of the field shows.

Events:

- `value-change`: `event.detail.value`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `value` as it was.
- `open-change`: `event.detail.open`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `open` as it was.
- `month-change`: `event.detail.month`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `month` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `field`: `kui-range`
- `segment`
- `input`
- `trigger`
- `positioner`: `kui-align`, `kui-align-offset`, `kui-anchor`, `kui-arrow-padding`, `kui-collision-boundary`, `kui-collision-padding`, `kui-position-method`, `kui-side`, `kui-side-offset`, `kui-sticky`
- `popup`
- `calendar`
- `heading`
- `previous`
- `next`
- `grid`
- `head-cell`
- `cell`
- `day`
- `clear`
- `preset`: `kui-value`

Lists (`<template kui-each="…">`): `segments`, `weekdays`, `months`, `weeks`, `days`.

Anatomy:

```
<kui-date-picker>
  field (repeated)
    <template kui-each="segments">
      segment (repeated)
    input
  trigger
  portal
    positioner
      popup
        calendar
          <template kui-each="months"> (optional)
            heading
            grid
              <template kui-each="weekdays">
                head-cell (repeated)
              <template kui-each="weeks">
                <template kui-each="days">
                  cell (repeated)
                    day
          previous
          next
  clear (optional)
  preset (optional, repeated)
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- field: The field a day is typed in: with `mode: "range"`, one for the first day (`range="start"`) and one for the last (`range="end"`).
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- segment: One piece of the date: a part that is typed, or what stands between two.
    - `data-segment="era | day | month | year | literal"`: Which piece it is: the era only in a calendar of several eras.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present on a part that is empty.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-invalid`: Present when the date is outside what it takes, or is asked for and half typed.
- trigger: The button that opens the popover, and what it is placed against.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the popover is open.
    - `data-pressed`: Present while the popover a press on this trigger opened is open: it stays pressed, as a button held down.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-anchor-hidden`: Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
    - `--positioner-width`: The popup's width, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `width: var(--positioner-width)` to animate a change of size.
    - `--positioner-height`: The popup's height, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `height: var(--positioner-height)` to animate a change of size.
- popup: The popover itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="click | dismiss"`: Present when it opened or closed in a way that should skip the motion: `click` when the keyboard pressed the trigger, `dismiss` when Escape closed it.
    - `--popup-width`: Its width: `auto`, and while its content changes size, the old width and then the new one, for a transition between them.
    - `--popup-height`: Its height: `auto`, and while its content changes size, the old height and then the new one, for a transition between them.
- calendar: The calendar.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when its value cannot be changed.
- previous: Shows the month before.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- next: Shows the month after.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- cell: A day's cell.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Also on a copy of one (a day of the month before or after, shown in its own month too), which is drawn as the day is but has no aria-selected.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range, and on a copy of it.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range, and on a copy of it.
- day: The button for a day.
    - `data-selected`: Present on a chosen day, on every day of a chosen range, and on each day of a list. Also on a copy of one (a day of the month before or after, shown in its own month too), which is drawn as the day is but has no aria-selected.
    - `data-today`: Present on today.
    - `data-outside-month`: Present on the days of the month before and after that fill the first and last weeks.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-unavailable`: Present on a day that cannot be chosen.
    - `data-range-start`: Present on the first day of a range, and on a copy of it.
    - `data-range-end`: Present on the last day of a range, and on a copy of it.
- clear: Empties the value, and gives focus to the field. Disabled while there is none.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- preset: Makes the value the day, or the range, it is given. Pressed while the value is that.
    - `data-pressed`: Present while the value is the one it gives.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

These parts write no state attribute or CSS variable of their own: `input`, `heading`, `grid` and `headCell`.

### Dialog

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/dialog"
```

`<kui-dialog>`: `<kui-dialog>` around a `kui-part="trigger"` button and a `portal`, which is drawn at the end of the page while the dialog is open and holds its `backdrop` and its `popup`, with a `title`, a `description` and a `close` button. The trigger and the close take `kui-disabled`. A long dialog's popup is in a `viewport`, which scrolls. `open`, `default-open`, `modal`, `disable-pointer-dismissal`; it tells `open-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `open` (boolean): Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `default-open` (boolean): Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `modal` (boolean): Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `disable-pointer-dismissal` (boolean): Keeps it open when the pointer presses outside it. Default `false`. Escape always closes it: a caller who must keep it open cancels the change whose `details.reason` is `"escape-key"`.

Events:

- `open-change`: `event.detail.open`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `open` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `trigger`
- `backdrop`
- `viewport`
- `popup`
- `title`
- `description`
- `close`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-dialog>
  trigger
  portal
    backdrop
    viewport (optional)
      popup
        title
        description
        close
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
- viewport: What a long dialog scrolls in: it lies over the page, between the backdrop and the popup. A press on it beside the popup is a press outside the dialog; a press on its scrollbar is not.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested`: Present when the dialog opened over another dialog.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
- popup: The dialog itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested`: Present when the dialog opened over another dialog.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.
- close: A button that closes the dialog.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

These parts write no state attribute or CSS variable of their own: `title` and `description`.

### Drawer

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/drawer"
```

`<kui-drawer>`: `<kui-drawer>`: a dialog that comes from an edge and is dragged back to it, with the dialog's parts. `open`, `default-open`, `modal`, `disable-pointer-dismissal`, `swipe-direction`, `snap-points` (with commas between: `0.4,1` or `200px,1`), `snap-point`, `default-snap-point`; it tells `open-change` and `snap-point-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `open` (boolean): Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `default-open` (boolean): Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `modal` (boolean): Blocks the page behind it and traps focus. Default `true`.
- `disable-pointer-dismissal` (boolean): Keeps it open when the pointer presses outside it. Default `false`. Escape always closes it: a caller who must keep it open cancels the change whose `details.reason` is `"escape-key"`.
- `swipe-direction` (string): The way it is dragged to close it: the edge it came from. Default: `"down"`.
- `snap-points` (string): Places it rests at, each how much of itself shows: a share (`0.4`, or `"40%"`) or a length (`"148px"`, `"20rem"`). `[0.4, 1]` is a drawer that opens two fifths shown and is dragged up to the whole. Without any, it is whole.
- `snap-point` (string): Which of them it rests at, as it was given.
- `default-snap-point` (string): Where it opens. Default: the smallest.

Events:

- `open-change`: `event.detail.open`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `open` as it was.
- `snap-point-change`: `event.detail.snapPoint`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `snapPoint` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `trigger`
- `backdrop`
- `popup`
- `title`
- `description`
- `close`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-drawer>
  trigger
  portal
    backdrop
    popup
      title
      description
      close
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The button that opens the dialog.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the dialog is open.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- backdrop: The layer over the page behind the dialog.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `data-swipe-dismiss`: Present once a drag has closed the drawer.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
    - `--drawer-swipe-strength`: Always 1: the backdrop takes the design's own time to leave, however the drawer was thrown.
    - `--drawer-height`: While the drawer is dragged: the height of the drawer in front.
- popup: The drawer. A design moves it by what it says of the drag, and gives it `touch-action: none` where a finger drags it.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-nested`: Present when the dialog opened over another dialog.
    - `data-nested-dialog-open`: Present when another dialog is open above this one.
    - `data-swiping`: Present while the drawer is dragged.
    - `data-swipe-direction="up | down | left | right"`: The way it is dragged to close it.
    - `data-swipe-dismiss`: Present once a drag has closed it.
    - `data-expanded`: Present while it rests whole, of several snap points.
    - `data-nested-drawer-open`: Present while another drawer is open over it.
    - `data-nested-drawer-swiping`: Present while a drawer over it is dragged.
    - `--nested-dialogs`: How many dialogs are open above this one.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-x`: How far it has been dragged across.
    - `--drawer-swipe-movement-y`: How far it has been dragged up or down.
    - `--drawer-swipe-progress`: How far it has been dragged, of its own size: 0 to 1.
    - `--drawer-snap-point-offset`: How far from whole it rests, towards the edge it closes at: 0px at its largest snap point.
    - `--drawer-height`: Its height.
    - `--nested-drawers`: How many drawers are open over it.
    - `--drawer-frontmost-height`: The height of the drawer in front of every other, while this one is open.
    - `--drawer-swipe-strength`: Once let go: 0.1 to 1, the share of the design's own time it should take to come to rest. A drawer thrown hard arrives sooner.
    - `--drawer-width`: Its width.
- close: A button that closes the dialog.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

These parts write no state attribute or CSS variable of their own: `title` and `description`.

### Editable

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/editable"
```

`<kui-editable>`: `<kui-editable>` around `kui-part="root"`, a `preview`, which says the text (or the placeholder while there is none) unless the page gave it something to say, an `input` or a textarea, and `edit-trigger`, `submit-trigger` and `cancel-trigger` buttons. The input's id is the element's `kui-id`. `value`, `default-value`, `editing`, `default-editing`, `placeholder`, `activation`, `submit-on-blur`, `select-on-focus`, `disabled`, `read-only`, `required`, `name`, `form`; it tells `value-change` and `editing-change`. Inside a `<kui-field>` its input is the field's control.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `value` (string): The text it holds: what the preview shows, and what editing starts from.
- `default-value` (string): The text it starts with, when the caller does not hold `value`. Read once.
- `editing` (boolean): Whether it is being edited, when the caller holds it.
- `default-editing` (boolean): Read once.
- `placeholder` (string): What the preview shows while the text is empty.
- `activation` (string): What on the preview starts an edit: focus reaching it (the default), a press, two presses, or nothing, where only the edit trigger does.
- `submit-on-blur` (boolean): Whether focus leaving the input keeps the edit (the default) or drops it.
- `select-on-focus` (boolean): Whether the text is selected as editing starts. Default `true`.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: it cannot be edited.
- `read-only` (boolean): Shown as it is, not editable.
- `required` (boolean): Needed: in a `Field`, leaving it empty is then invalid.
- `name` (string): With a name, the text is submitted with the form around it; in a `Field`, the field's by default.
- `form` (string): The id of the form the input belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Events:

- `value-change`: `event.detail.value`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `value` as it was.
- `editing-change`: `event.detail.editing`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `editing` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`
- `preview`
- `input`
- `edit-trigger`
- `submit-trigger`
- `cancel-trigger`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-editable>
  root
    preview
    input
    edit-trigger (optional)
    submit-trigger (optional)
    cancel-trigger (optional)
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A text edited in place. Enter keeps the edit (in a `<textarea>`, where Enter is a new line, Ctrl or ⌘ with Enter) and Escape drops it, focus going back to the edit trigger (or the preview where there is none); focus leaving the input keeps the edit, or drops it with `submitOnBlur` `false`. Inside a `Field` its input is the field's control: the field's label names it, and a press on the label starts an edit.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.
- preview: The text as it reads, or the placeholder while there is none: hidden while editing.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.
- input: Where the text is typed, an `<input>` or a `<textarea>`: hidden unless editing.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.
- editTrigger: Starts an edit: hidden while editing.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.
- submitTrigger: Keeps what was typed: hidden unless editing.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.
- cancelTrigger: Drops what was typed: hidden unless editing.
    - `data-editing`: Present while it is being edited.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-readonly`: Present when it is shown and cannot be edited.
    - `data-placeholder`: Present while it holds no text.
    - `data-touched`: In a field: present once focus has left it.
    - `data-dirty`: In a field: present while the text is not the one it began with.
    - `data-filled`: In a field: present while it holds text.
    - `data-focused`: In a field: present while it has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the text was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the text is wrong.

### Field

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/field"
```

`<kui-field>`: `<kui-field>` around `kui-part="root"`, a `label`, a `control` (an input, a textarea or a select), a `description` and an `error`, which is in the page while something is wrong and says what, unless the page gave it something to say (`kui-match="valueMissing"` for one finding of the browser's, `kui-match` alone for always). `name`, `disabled`, `invalid`, `validation-mode`, `validation-debounce-time`; `validate` as a property.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `name` (string): The control's name in the form.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disables the field: its control cannot be changed, and its parts say so (`data-disabled`).
- `invalid` (boolean): Invalid whatever the value: an error known from elsewhere.
- `validation-mode` (string): When the value is checked; the form's by default, else `"onSubmit"`.
- `validation-debounce-time` (number): With `"onChange"`, how long the value must rest before it is checked, in milliseconds.

Properties only:

- `validate`: The field's own check, after the browser's: a message or several when the value is wrong, `null` when it is right. It may answer later, with a promise.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`
- `label`
- `control`
- `description`
- `error`: `kui-match`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-field>
  root
    label
    control
    description
    error (repeated)
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: A control with its label, its description and its errors.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- label: The control's name: a press on it reaches the control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- control: The control: an input, a textarea or a select.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- description: More about the control, said after its name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
- error: What is wrong with the value. In the page while it applies. Several, each with its own `match`, can be shown at once: each has an id of its own, and the control names them all.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the control.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the control has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the control has focus.
    - `data-valid`: Present once the value has been checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: Present while the value is wrong.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.

### Fieldset

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/fieldset"
```

`<kui-fieldset>`: `<kui-fieldset>` around a `kui-part="root"` fieldset and its `legend`. `disabled`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `disabled` (boolean): Disables every field inside.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`
- `legend`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-fieldset>
  root
    legend
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: The group of fields.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
- legend: The group's name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.

### FileUpload

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/file-upload"
```

`<kui-file-upload>`: `<kui-file-upload>` around `kui-part="root"`, which holds a `trigger` button (in a `dropzone`, or beside one, or with none), a `list` with a `<template kui-each="items">` for a file (`{name}`, `{size}` in bytes, `{type}` and `{index}` are its own), and a `clear` button. An `item` holds its `item-name` and `item-size`, which say the file's name and its size as people read one (in the language of its `kui-locale`) unless the page wrote something, and an `item-remove` button. The root draws the native file input, hidden, as its last child. `accept`, `multiple`, `max-files`, `max-size`, `min-size`, `disabled`, `required`, `name`, `form`; `files`, `default-files` and `validate` as properties. It tells `files-change` and `files-reject` (`detail.rejections`).

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `accept` (string): What may be taken, as a file input's `accept`: extensions (`".png"`), types (`"image/png"`) and kinds (`"image/*"`), in a list or one text with commas. Without it, anything.
- `multiple` (boolean): Whether several files are held. Default `false`: a file taken is the one held.
- `max-files` (number): With `multiple`, how many files it holds at most.
- `max-size` (number): The largest a file may be, in bytes.
- `min-size` (number): The smallest a file may be, in bytes.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: no file can be taken or removed.
- `required` (boolean): Needed: in a `Field`, holding none is then invalid.
- `name` (string): With a name, the files are submitted with the form around them.
- `form` (string): The id of the form the control belongs to, when it is not inside it.

Properties only:

- `files`: The files it holds, in order.
- `defaultFiles`: The files it starts with, when the caller does not hold `files`. Read once.
- `validate`: Whether a file may be taken, asked after the checks above.

Events:

- `files-change`: `event.detail.files`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `files` as it was.
- `files-reject`: `event.detail.rejections`, with `event.detail.details`. It reports something that happened: there is nothing to keep.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`
- `dropzone`
- `trigger`
- `list`
- `item`
- `item-name`
- `item-size`: `kui-locale`
- `item-remove`
- `clear`

Lists (`<template kui-each="…">`): `items`.

Anatomy:

```
<kui-file-upload>
  root
    dropzone (optional)
      trigger (as above)
    trigger
    list
      <template kui-each="items">
        item (repeated)
          item-name
          item-size (optional)
          item-remove (optional)
    clear (optional)
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- root: Files chosen to be sent. It holds the hidden file input, as its last child, and takes files pasted while focus is in it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
    - `data-empty`: Present while it holds no file.
- dropzone: Where files are dropped; a pointer's press on it opens the file picker. A group (`role="group"`), not a control: the trigger is the keyboard's way in, in it or beside it.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- trigger: The button that opens the file picker: the control, which works with no dropzone in the page.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- list: What holds the files: a list.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- item: A file.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- itemName: A file's name.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- itemSize: A file's size, as people read one.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- itemRemove: A file's button that takes it away.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.
- clear: Takes every file away: hidden while there is none.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-dragging`: Present while files are dragged over the dropzone.
    - `data-required`: Present when a file is needed.

### Form

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/form"
```

`<kui-form>`: `<kui-form>` around a `kui-part="root"` form. Its fields are checked when it is submitted; valid, it tells `form-submit` with their values and the page is not left. `validation-mode`; `errors` (from outside the page, by field name) as a property; it tells `clear-errors`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `validation-mode` (string): When the form's fields check their values, unless a field says otherwise. Default `"onSubmit"`.

Properties only:

- `errors`: Errors from outside the page (a server's), by field name. A field shows its own until its value changes.

Events:

- `form-submit`: `event.detail.values`, with `event.detail.details`. It reports something that happened: there is nothing to keep.
- `clear-errors`: `event.detail.errors`, with `event.detail.details`. It reports something that happened: there is nothing to keep.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-form>
  root
```

This part writes no state attribute or CSS variable of its own: `root`.

### HoverCard

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/hover-card"
```

`<kui-hover-card>`: `<kui-hover-card>` around a `kui-part="trigger"` link and a `portal` with a `positioner` around the `popup`, which the pointer may enter. `open`, `default-open`, `delay`, `close-delay`, `disabled`; it tells `open-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `open` (boolean): Whether it is open, when the caller holds it.
- `default-open` (boolean): Whether it starts open, when the caller does not hold `open`. Read once.
- `delay` (number): How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the popup opens, in milliseconds.
- `close-delay` (number): How long after the pointer leaves the popup closes, in milliseconds.
- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: the pointer and focus do not open it.

Events:

- `open-change`: `event.detail.open`, with `event.detail.details`. `preventDefault()` keeps `open` as it was.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `trigger`: `kui-close-delay`, `kui-delay`
- `positioner`: `kui-align`, `kui-align-offset`, `kui-anchor`, `kui-arrow-padding`, `kui-collision-boundary`, `kui-collision-padding`, `kui-position-method`, `kui-side`, `kui-side-offset`, `kui-sticky`
- `popup`
- `arrow`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-hover-card>
  trigger
  portal
    positioner
      popup
        arrow
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- trigger: The link the card previews.
    - `data-popup-open`: Present when the card is open.
- positioner: Places the popup against the trigger. It carries the geometry.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-anchor-hidden`: Present while the anchor is out of view: scrolled away, or clipped by a box around it.
    - `--anchor-width`: The anchor's width.
    - `--anchor-height`: The anchor's height.
    - `--available-width`: The width between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--available-height`: The height between the anchor and the edge of the viewport.
    - `--transform-origin`: The point of the popup nearest its anchor, to scale from.
    - `--positioner-width`: The popup's width, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `width: var(--positioner-width)` to animate a change of size.
    - `--positioner-height`: The popup's height, as its content lays it out: a design gives the positioner `height: var(--positioner-height)` to animate a change of size.
- popup: The card itself.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-starting-style`: Present for the first style of its entrance: what it animates in from.
    - `data-ending-style`: Present through its exit: what it animates out to. It leaves the page when the motion ends.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-instant="delay | focus | dismiss"`: Present when it opened or closed without its usual wait, for a design that skips the motion then.
- arrow: An element that points at the trigger, placed along the popup's edge.
    - `data-open`: Present when it is open.
    - `data-closed`: Present when it is closed.
    - `data-side="top | right | bottom | left | inline-start | inline-end"`: The side of the anchor it is on, after any flip. Asked for as `inline-start` or `inline-end`, it says one of those two when it is beside its anchor.
    - `data-align="start | center | end"`: How it is aligned with the anchor.
    - `data-uncentered`: Present when the popup was pushed along its edge, so the arrow is not at the trigger's centre.

### Input

```
import "@kirana-ui/web/input"
```

`<kui-input>`: `<kui-input>` around a `kui-part="root"` input or textarea: it says its state, and inside a `<kui-field>` it is the field's control. `disabled`; it tells `value-change`.

Attributes of the element (each also a property, in camel case):

- `disabled` (boolean): Disabled: nothing can be typed in it.

Events:

- `value-change`: `event.detail.value`, with `event.detail.details`. It reports something that happened: there is nothing to keep.

Parts (`kui-part`), each with the `kui-` attributes its element is read for:

- `root`

Anatomy:

```
<kui-input>
  root
```

Attributes and CSS variables, by part:

- input: A text input. Inside a field it is the field's control.
    - `data-disabled`: Present when it is disabled.
    - `data-touched`: Present once focus has left the input.
    - `data-dirty`: Present while the value is not the one it started with.
    - `data-filled`: Present while the input has a value.
    - `data-focused`: Present while the input has focus.
    - `data-valid`: In a field: present once the value was checked and found right.
    - `data-invalid`: In a field: present while the value is wrong.

<kui-label>
